pages.text: A fresh Coolant Cell holds 100 charges. A successful swap uses one charge from the initiating computer.

pages.title: Refill a Cell
pages.text: Combine the two in any crafting slots.
Place the cell in the screen's slot or feed it with a hopper pointing down into the top of the computer. Take a used cell out through the screen when it needs a refill.
